data.long_meaning: The name Bachchu is derived from the Hindi word 'bachcha', which means 'little one' or 'child'. In Hindu mythology, the name is also associated with Lord Krishna, who was affectionately called 'Bachchhan' or 'Little Krishna'. The name Bachchu carries the meaning “Little One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bachchu usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a common name given to boys and is often used as a term of endearment for young children. The name underscores the importance of family, love, and nurturing in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Bachchu' holds immense significance in Hinduism. It is associated with Lord Krishna, who is regarded as the embodiment of love, compassion, and mischief. The name not only represents the childlike innocence of Krishna but also reminds us of the divine playfulness of the divine. It encourages us to embrace the joy and wonder of life, just as a child does.
